name: tiles-gallery-server
description: Express.js + TypeScript backend for Tiles Gallery (SCIC/EJP-13 Compliant)

scripts.build: prisma migrate deploy --schema=../prisma/schema.prisma && prisma generate --schema=../prisma/schema.prisma && node -e "if(require('fs').existsSync('../prisma/generated/client')) require('fs').cpSync('../prisma/generated/client', './node_modules/@prisma/client', {recursive: true, force: true})" && tsc
